title: Enhancing Mango Foliage Diagnostic Systems: Real-Time Edge Deployment via TensorRT Quantization and Multi-Label Pathological Co-Occurrence
content: Deep learning architectures deployed for automated agricultural diagnostics face operational constraints on edge platforms due to high latency, memory footprints, and single-class classification limitations. This paper presents an optimized, interpretable diagnostic pipeline that compresses a ResNet-50 backbone using TensorRT post-training INT8 quantization for edge execution on embedded hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson modules). Furthermore, we expand the single-label classification model into a multi-label classification framework capable of detecting concurrent foliar diseases such as simultaneous Anthracnose lesions and Powdery Mildew fungal coverage on individual mango leaves. Evaluated on an augmented dataset derived from MangoLeafBD, the quantized INT8 network achieves an inference latency of 4.2 ms per frame (a 5.2x speedup over FP32) with a minimal loss in diagnostic accuracy (98.85 FP32 vs. 98.12INT8). Coupled with Grad-CAM localization, this framework provides robust, real-time visual interpretations for complex multi-pathogen agricultural environments.
